items.label: sample
items.needle: This synthetic study compares two inspection routes over six weekday trials.

items.label: qualification
items.needle: The observations describe this sample only; weather and staffing were held constant.

items.label: table caption
items.needle: Table 1 records median elapsed time and the number of missed handoffs.

items.label: interpretation
items.needle: The check-first route was faster by 7 minutes, but this is not a causal estimate.

items.label: figure caption
items.needle: Figure 1. Gate order: check, test, then release; each gate must pass before the next.

items.label: scope limitation
items.needle: The trial excluded overnight operations and must not be generalized to storms.

items.label: protocol reference
items.needle: [1] Harbor Lab. Handoff protocol, synthetic edition, 2026, sections 2-3.

items.label: trial reference
items.needle: [2] Harbor Lab. Trial log, synthetic edition, 2026, entries 1-6.

items.label: definition
items.needle: A missed handoff means a parcel waited more than 5 minutes after its release signal.

items.label: observation method
items.needle: Observers recorded one timestamp per gate and did not change the route mid-trial.
